name: ai-jury
description: Convene a cross-vendor multi-agent review jury (Claude Code + Codex by default; hosted model APIs, free local models and an opt-in Antigravity seat when configured) on a diff, PR, or issue: independent review, cross-examination, verification, and one verdict — a chair's synthesis or a panel vote.

interface.longDescription:
AI Jury convenes a panel of reviewers from different vendors on the same diff, pull request or issue. Each reviewer works independently, they cross-examine each other's findings, a verification round checks them against the diff, and the run ends in one verdict: a chair's synthesis or a panel vote.

Use it to get a second, third and fourth opinion on a change before merging, to gate a CI job on blocking findings, or to check an issue for completeness.

Limitations: the skill drives the separately installed `jury` command-line tool (pipx install ai-jury), which needs at least one reviewer available - the Claude Code or Codex CLI, a hosted model API key, or a local model server. The diff is sent to every reviewer you configure. It reviews; it does not edit your code.
defaultPrompt: Convene the review jury on my current branch
Run a cross-vendor review of pull request #123
Check whether issue #45 is ready to implement
